subject.title: Containerized/self-hosted deploys can't use externalized channel plugins: openKeyedStore is gated to trusted plugins, with no supported way to trust a self-hosted channel

question: Should OpenClaw add a provenance-preserving external official-plugin deployment path for immutable containers whose mounted runtime state hides image-baked install records?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the fix decides how external in-process plugins prove identity before receiving host-managed persistent state and channel ingress capabilities.

options.title: Design a trusted immutable install root
options.body: Add a provenance-preserving package/install-record location or packaging contract outside mutable runtime state, with doctor/inspect diagnostics and Docker proof.

options.title: Document state snapshot only
options.body: Keep the current trust gate unchanged and document that self-hosted images must ship and mount the same OpenClaw state directory containing the install record.

options.title: Reject this deployment model
options.body: Close as not planned and keep external channel keyed state limited to bundled or normal installer-managed active-state installs.

recommendation.title: Design a trusted immutable install root
recommendation.body: Add a provenance-preserving package/install-record location or packaging contract outside mutable runtime state, with doctor/inspect diagnostics and Docker proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the issue and already supplied the maintainer-side trust-model framing in the discussion.
